name: Storefront and warehouse — client reconnect synchronization
note: A focused reconnect probe with a known seed. West remains 45, so changing East from 55 to 7 must produce 52. It does not inherit the West=10 state from the server-restart criterion.

features.name: A reconnecting storefront catches up to an external write

criteria.desc: while the storefront is offline, a direct database write sets Desk Lamp's East stock to 7; after reconnecting, the same page catches up from 100 to the authoritative total of 52
criteria.note: This proposed score remains draft until the focused pristine and mutation controls are qualified.
